name: gi-foreign-tax-relief
description: Gibraltar domestic foreign-tax relief under Income Tax Act section 37 and UK treaty Article 22 coordination. Covers same-income evidence, source and residence-only exclusions, proportional allocation of Gibraltar tax, overseas relief interaction, six-year claims and later adjustments. Adds the ordinary corporate tax-residence exit base, retained-PE asset boundary, conditional five-year deferral and cessation triggers. Includes recomputable credit/exit examples and working-paper controls. Based on the official March 2026 consolidation checked in October 2026. Does not decide treaty residence, source disputes or foreign-country entitlement. Professional attestation is pending.
